verses.gurmukhi: ਇਕ ਮਨਿ ਹੋਇ ਇਕਾਦਸੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਰਤੁ ਪਤਿਬ੍ਰਤਿ ਭਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: eik man hoi ikaadhasee gurmukh varat patibrat bhaiaa|

en.bdb: Like a faithful wife, gurmukh likes the fast of ekadasi in the form of concentration of mind (Hindus generally observe fast on the eleventh day of lunar month).

verses.gurmukhi: ਗਿਆਰਹ ਰੁਦ੍ਰ੍ਰ ਸਮੰੁਦ੍ਰ ਵਿਚਿ ਪਲ ਦਾ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: giaareh rudhrr sama(n)udhr vich pal dhaa paaraavaar na paiaa|

en.bdb: Eleven Rudras (different forms of Siva) could not understand the mystery of this world - ocean.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗਿਆਰਹ ਕਸ ਗਿਆਰਹ ਕਸੇ ਕਸਿ ਕਸਵੱਟੀ ਕਸ ਕਸਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: giaareh kas giaareh kase kas kasava'Tee kas kasaiaa|

en.bdb: The gurmukh has controlled all the eleven (ten organs and the mind). Their eleven objects also he has controlled and he has purified the mind-gold by rubbing it on the touchstone  of devotion.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗਿਆਰਹ ਗੁਣ ਫੈਲਾਉ ਕਰਿ ਕਚ ਪਕਾਈ ਅਘੜ ਘੜਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: giaareh gun failaau kar kach pakaiee aghaR ghaRaiaa|

en.bdb: Cultivating eleven virtues he has chiseled and stabilized the tardy mind.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗਿਆਰਹ ਦਾਉ ਚੜ੍ਹਾਉ ਕਰਿ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਉ ਕੁਦਾਉ ਰਹਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: giaareh dhaau chaRhaau kar dhoojaa bhaau kudhaau rahaiaa|

en.bdb: Assuming eleven virtues (truth, contentment, compassion, dharma, control, devotion etc.) he has erased duality and dubiousness.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗਿਆਰਹ ਗੇੜਾ ਸਿਖੁ ਸੁਣਿ ਗੁਰ ਸਿਖੁ ਲੈ ਗੁਰਸਿਖੁ ਸਦਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: giaareh geRaa sikh sun gur sikh lai gursikh sadhaiaa|

en.bdb: Listening to the mantra eleven times, the gurmukh adopting the teaching of the Guru, is called Gursikh.
In the holy congregation only the Word-Guru resides in one's heart.
